ledger: Dancer | woman with hair in a bun wearing a black cross-back sports bra and black leggings, tattoos on left forearm and right shoulder, standing barefoot facing a studio mirror | same appearance and wardrobe, standing in front of the mirror with right arm raised overhead and right foot pointed | at 00:02 her pose abruptly jumps to having her left arm raised and weight on her left leg (mismatching her mirror reflection) before snapping back to her previous right-arm-raised movement at 00:03

Dancer's mirror reflection | reflection facing forward in the studio mirror matching the dancer's right-arm raise at 00:00-00:01 | matches the dancer's pose with the arm on the viewer's right raised overhead at 00:06-00:09 | at 00:02 the reflection raises the arm on the viewer's right while the foreground dancer has her left arm (viewer's left) raised

findings.description: Between 00:01 and 00:03, the dancer is in the middle of raising and lowering her right arm with her weight on her right leg, but at 00:02 she abruptly teleports into a completely different pose with her left arm raised straight overhead, her right arm down by her hip, and her weight shifted onto her left leg (while her mirror reflection simultaneously shows the opposite arm raised on the viewer's right), before snapping back to her original stance and right-arm motion at 00:03.
